source.caption: An illustration of our annotation UI. Annotators mark points on the image to indicate artifact/implausibility regions (red points) or misaligned regions (blue points) w.r.t the text prompt. Then, they click on the words to mark the misaligned keywords (underlined and shaded) and choose the scores for plausibility, text-image alignment, aesthetics, and overall quality (underlined).
